# Ethereum/India Institutional Evidence Portal

> A six-module evidence base on Ethereum and distributed-settlement infrastructure for Indian institutional finance. Every claim carries a source and date; every quantitative figure carries a source tier (T1 primary … T5 crypto media/aggregator) in the Figure Ledger.

- [Overview](index.html)
- [What shipped](what-shipped.html)
- [What's legal in India](whats-legal-in-india.html)
- [Where the value is](where-the-value-is.html)
- [Ethereum vs alternatives](ethereum-vs-alternatives.html)
- [The objections](the-objections.html)
- [How adoption happens](how-adoption-happens.html)
- [Figure Ledger](ledger.html)
- [Reconciliation](reconciliation.html)
- [The Devcon pitch](devcon-pitch.html)

## Data
- [Figure Ledger data (JSON)](data/figures.json) — every quantitative claim with its claim, figure, unit, source, date, tier and flags.
